ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... Folder 4 holds the tongue chart. ... Folder 8 holds the skull chart. ... Folder 6 holds the ear chart. ... In which folder is the chart on the body part that tastes food?" -> answer org 4; the alt prompt asks about the ear (bridge alt), its 2nd statement. Possible answers after the patch: 6 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 8 (answer at the same statement slot), 9 (the alt prompt's own answer), 4 (answer org kept).
